name: LPKF Laser & Electronics SE
blurb: LPKF is a German laser-systems specialist whose product lines span PCB prototyping, solar-cell scribing, plastic welding and - most strategically - LIDE (Laser-Induced Deep Etching), a proprietary process for high-precision drilling and structuring of thin glass. LIDE is the company's bet on advanced semiconductor packaging: glass interposers and glass core substrates that route signals between chiplets, and are increasingly seen as enablers for co-packaged optics. The competitive set is small (Schott, Corning and a handful of equipment vendors), but LPKF's incumbency in the actual etching step is differentiated.
recent: Q1 2026 revenue fell about 32% year-over-year as the legacy solar segment continues its planned wind-down, and adjusted EBIT was down 68%. Management nevertheless reaffirmed 2026 guidance of EUR 105-120m revenue and an adjusted EBIT margin between -3.0% and 4.5%, while flagging that LIDE remains in test-and-R&D rollout with major semiconductor customers and that follow-up production orders are expected in 2026 with a ramp into 2027-28. Shares re-rated sharply on the CPO and glass-substrate narrative, trading near EUR 20 in early May 2026 against a 52-week low of EUR 5.35. The 'North Star' restructuring program targets a sustainable double-digit EBIT margin by 2028.
